body:
on the back: “saturday before sunrise, waxy pollen in the weathered bundle after the fertilizer trial. our cat hid from the water bowl. later, traffic was turned around.”

A pencil line had been rubbed thin but not erased. I could still read enough of it to recognize what had been there first.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached this place before they closed the road.
title: weathered bundle note — saturday before sunrise
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the waxy pollen while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
